definitions.explanation: Urgent medical treatment or the system providing it. Used as a prefix in many medical compound words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{救急|きゅうきゅう}{箱|ばこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where is the first aid kit?

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧{救急|きゅうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: I had difficulty finding a facility that would accept nighttime emergency patients.

notes:
USAGE:
{救急|きゅうきゅう} is most commonly encountered as a prefix in compound words related to emergency medical care. The number to call for an ambulance in Japan is 119.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧ (ambulance)
- {救急|きゅうきゅう}{箱|ばこ} (first aid kit)
- {救急|きゅうきゅう}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ (emergency hospital)
- {救急|きゅうきゅう}⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧ (emergency transport)
- {救急|きゅうきゅう}{隊員|たいいん} (paramedic)
- {救急|きゅうきゅう}⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧ (emergency treatment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{応急|おうきゅう}→応急：08193_oukyuu⟧ means "emergency" in the sense of a temporary or stopgap measure: ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}{処置|しょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧ (first aid, emergency treatment). {救急|きゅうきゅう} is specifically about the medical emergency care system.
